transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah… I’ve been having trouble staying locked in on things at work. Like I’ll start a safety briefing or go over a plan review trying to pay attention, and a few minutes in my mind’s already on three other job problems. Then I miss stuff I really should’ve caught.
Are you finding that these problems with focusing at work are causing you a lot of stress or anxiety?

Yeah… it’s been stressing me out. Work’s gotten to the point where missed follow-ups and messy coordination on site got my employer formally concerned. And at home… my wife’s pretty worn down having to keep reminding me about things I said I’d handle.
Are you having trouble focusing at home as well, or is it mainly at work?

Mostly work, I guess. That’s where I notice it most — like in briefings or plan reviews, I’m trying to pay attention and then a few minutes later my head’s already on other job stuff, and I realize I missed something.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or blurting out answers before they finish speaking?
Yeah… I do that sometimes. I’ll think I know where someone’s going with a question and jump in too fast. Then they finish and I realize I missed the main part.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety, like you can't sit still?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid much attention to that. I mean, I probably shift around some, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it as a big thing.
Do you often find yourself talking excessively, more than others?
Yeah… probably. If it’s about a job problem, I can get going and keep explaining it from every angle. Sometimes I can tell the guys are ready to move on and I’m still talking.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Yeah… I guess in conversations I do. I’ll cut someone off because I think I know what they’re asking, and I answer too quick. Then sometimes I realize they hadn’t gotten to the important part yet.
Do you often have trouble completing tasks or projects that you've started?

Yeah. That happens. Like after a site walk, if someone gives me a list of follow-ups, I’ll get the first one or two done, then something else comes up and… later I realize I never sent the email or called the subcontractor or closed the issue out.
Do you often have difficulty waiting for your turn?
Yeah… I do. Waiting on a call, or at the permit office, even just in line, it gets under my skin. I’m checking the time, shifting around… trying not to push ahead, basically.
Do you think your difficulties with focus and impulsivity have been present since you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, even in elementary school, teachers were telling my parents I couldn’t stay in my seat, talked out of turn, lost homework… stuff like that. I’d rush through directions before I really understood them too.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble engaging in activities quietly?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t usually think of it that way. I guess I can get kind of antsy, but… I don’t know. Depends what I’m doing.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your level of focus or impulsivity as you've gotten older?

Yeah… it’s been worse the last couple years, I’d say. Maybe a little over two years. Since the construction schedule changed and the hours got all over the place, it’s been messing with my job pretty bad.
Have you ever had a period of at least six months where you didn't have any of these focus or impulsivity problems?
Not really, no. I mean, it’s always been kind of there, but it’s been seriously getting in the way at work for… about two years and a couple months, since the schedule got more chaotic.
Have you ever had a period of at least a few years as an adult where you didn't struggle with focus or impulsivity?
I don’t think so. It’s been there off and on, but it’s really been causing problems at work for about two years and a couple months, since the schedule changed and the hours got more chaotic.
Have you generally experienced these difficulties with focus and impulsivity in your personal relationships and daily life outside of work as well?

Yeah… it’s not just work. Work’s where it’s gotten me in real trouble — missed follow-ups, site stuff not coordinated right, my employer’s raised concerns. But at home too… my wife’s pretty worn out having to keep reminding me about things I said I’d take care of.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and impulsivity in settings other than work and home?
I’m not really sure. I mean, mostly I notice it at work and at home. Other places… nothing specific comes to mind.
Have you ever been diagnosed with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder or ADHD?
No… not officially. Not that I know of.
Do you think your difficulties with impulsivity are more of a problem for you than your difficulties with paying attention?
Maybe impulsivity, yeah. I’ll cut people off because I think I know where they’re going with a question, and I answer too fast. Then I realize I missed the part they hadn’t even said yet.
Do you think your difficulties with impulsivity and attention have been relatively consistent across your life, or have they varied significantly at different times?

I think it’s been there a long time. Like, even back in elementary school, teachers were telling my parents I couldn’t stay in my seat, talked out of turn, lost homework… stuff like that. I’d rush through directions before I really understood them too. So yeah, I guess it’s been pretty consistent.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't struggle with paying attention?
Not really. I mean, I can try hard—like in a safety briefing or going over a plan—but after a few minutes my head’s already on three other job problems, and I’ll miss stuff I should’ve caught.
